# Regenerative Farming Philippines

> A farming family from Calamba, Laguna, teaching the regenerative farming
> method for tropical farms: soil health, compost and biofertilizers, cover
> cropping, natural pest management, and season-aware planning. The family farm
> is Viking Farms PH, three generations on the same land.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/): the regenerative method, taught by a farming family.
- [The Method (all ten modules)](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/method/): the complete curriculum, module by module.
- [What is regenerative agriculture](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/method/why/): the working definition, principles, and how it differs from organic and permaculture.
- [The course](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/the-method/): the ten-module self-paced course.
- [Our story](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/our-story/): three generations on the same land in Calamba, Laguna.

## Journal
- [The journal (all field guides)](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/): field guides from the beds and paddocks.
- [Regenerative gardening](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/regenerative-gardening/): the farm method scaled to a bed, a yard, or a handful of pots.
- [Regenerative vs sustainable agriculture](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/regenerative-vs-sustainable/): the real difference between the two words, plus organic and biodynamic, settled by the shopping-list test.
- [Integrated farming in the Philippines](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/integrated-farming/): crops, livestock, and fish trading inputs on one lot, with the loop map and the starter sequence.
- [Composting in the Philippines](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/composting-philippines/): rice straw, manure, and crop waste turned into fertility instead of smoke, with the pile method that survives tropical rain.
- [Rice straw to biofertilizer](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/rice-straw-biofertilizer/): the three ferments a small farm runs from its own waste, pointed back at the straw, with the equipment list and the honest arithmetic.
- [Reading the wet season](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/wet-season-planting/): when to plant, when to wait: the monsoon signs, the regional windows for rice and vegetables, and when waiting is the profitable move.
- [Soil testing: read the ground before you feed it](https://regenerativefarmingphilippines.com/journal/soil-test-philippines/): the free walk-over checks, the kit and MOET options, the lab route and its prices, and what each number changes about the season's spending.
